UPDATE tickets
    SET assignee_id = :agentId, assigned_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    WHERE id = :ticketId
    RETURNING id

UPDATE tickets
    SET state = :closedState, closed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    WHERE state = :resolvedState
    RETURNING id

SELECT id, subject, requester_id
    FROM tickets
    WHERE id = :ticketId
    LIMIT 1

SELECT id, subject, priority
    FROM tickets
    WHERE state = :state
    ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT priority, COUNT(*) AS total
    FROM tickets
    WHERE state = :state
    GROUP BY priority

SELECT t.id, t.subject, t.state
    FROM tickets t
    WHERE t.requester_id = :requesterId
    ORDER BY t.created_at DESC

SELECT id, subject
    FROM ticketing
    WHERE subject ILIKE '%sample%'

DELETE FROM tickets_preview
    WHERE expires_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    RETURNING id

UPDATE tickets
    SET state = :state, closed_at = NULL
    WHERE id = :ticketId
    RETURNING id

SELECT id, created_at
    FROM tickets
    WHERE archived = false

SELECT bin_code, sku, quantity
    FROM bin_balances
    WHERE bin_code = :binCode
    ORDER BY sku

SELECT sku, item_name, on_hand
    FROM stock_items
    WHERE on_hand <= reorder_point
    ORDER BY sku

UPDATE stock_items
    SET reserved = reserved - :quantity
    WHERE sku = :sku
    RETURNING sku

UPDATE stock_items
    SET reserved = reserved + :quantity
    WHERE sku = :sku
    RETURNING sku

SELECT zone, COUNT(*) AS total
    FROM bin_balances
    WHERE quantity > :minimum
    GROUP BY zone

SELECT sku, item_name, supplier_id
    FROM stock_items
    WHERE supplier_id = :supplierId
    ORDER BY item_name

SELECT id, item_name
    FROM stockroom
    WHERE item_name ILIKE '%sample%'

DELETE FROM stock_items_preview
    WHERE expires_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    RETURNING id

UPDATE stock_items
    SET on_hand = on_hand + :quantity
    WHERE sku = :sku
    RETURNING on_hand

SELECT id, created_at
    FROM stock_items
    WHERE archived = false

SELECT id, label
    FROM calibration_jobs
    WHERE active = :active
    ORDER BY id

UPDATE calibration_jobs
    SET complete = :complete
    WHERE id = :jobId
    RETURNING id

SELECT id, label
    FROM calibration
    WHERE label ILIKE '%sample%'

SELECT id, created_at
    FROM calibration_jobs
    WHERE archived = false
